claims.statement: For an arbitrary interior product bias and a genuine physical selector j, the parent biased Booleanity defects satisfy E_U=q E_U(G0)+t E_U(G1) and E_{U+{j}}=sqrt(tq)(E_U(G1)-E_U(G0)); hence the squared pair equals q E_U(G0)^2+t E_U(G1)^2 for every residual U, including normalization.
claims.scope: All finite Boolean gates, all interior product biases, all physical selector coordinates, all residual subsets U.

claims.statement: For every residual nonempty U, q v0 K0+t v1 K1 >= c_{j,U}^2/(4 L_U^2 ln 2), where c_{j,U}^2=q g_{0,U}^2+t g_{1,U}^2 is the exact paired child reference-gap energy. No selector factor L_j occurs.
claims.scope: All finite Boolean gates, all interior product biases, all physical selector coordinates; constant children interpreted with zero nonempty KL and zero gap.

claims.statement: The biased spectral entropy satisfies Htilde(G)=h2(t)+q Htilde(G0)+t Htilde(G1)+H(J|S)-H(B|S), with the signed interference retained in J; substituting the child I-projections and B13-CONDITIONAL-KL-BANK-v1 yields the explicit entropy upper bound in REPORT.md (4.4).
claims.scope: All finite Boolean gates and all interior product biases.

claims.statement: For the fleet03/B13 universally safe direction eta and any lambda>=0, the same selector carries q v0 K0+t v1 K1+lambda L_j >= c_{j,U}^2/(4 L_U^2 ln 2)+lambda r0 V_t delta(1-delta).
claims.scope: Exact scope of the fleet03/B13 safe-direction theorem plus the selector-conditional KL theorem above.
